title: Run
desc: Jhanvi and Siddharth are deeply in love, but her brother Ganpat, a gangster, disapproves of their relationship and plots to kill Siddharth.

title: Krrish
desc: Krrish, gifted with superhuman powers, falls for Priya and travels to Singapore, where shocking truths about his father push him to embrace destiny and fight.

title: Satyam Shivam Sundaram
desc: Rajeev marries Roopa, a beautiful singer, but he struggles to accept her when he discovers her disfigured face, causing emotional pain and conflict in their relationship.

title: Dhamaal
desc: Roy, Manav, Aditya and Boman chase a hidden treasure in Goa, but as Inspector Kabir gets on their trail, their fun-filled adventure turns into a chaotic race against time.

title: Phool Aur Kante
desc: Ajay, the son of a crime boss, lives peacefully until rivals kidnap his father. Forced into the underworld, he must confront danger and fight to save his family.

title: Company
desc: Chandu and Mallik form a gang and gain notoriety. But ego and tension tear them apart, leading to betrayal and the collapse of their criminal empire.

title: Anjaan Raahen
desc: In this gripping tale, Anand, a teacher in India, tackles sex education in a conservative school. Amidst personal struggles and accusations, he navigates complex relationships with students and colleagues.

title: Shubh Mangal Saavdhan
desc: Mudit, a shy boy, wins Sugandha's heart and plans marriage. But their relationship faces turmoil when they discover his erectile dysfunction, challenging their love before the wedding.

title: Laadla
desc: Headstrong factory owner Sheetal marries Raju, the union leader, intending to crush his spirit and teach him a lesson, but their clash soon turns into a battle of wills.

title: Mera Naam Joker
desc: Raju faces heartbreak and struggles in love throughout his life. As a circus clown, he hides his pain behind laughter, making others smile at the cost of his own sorrows.

title: Raid 2
desc: Income Tax officer Amay Patnaik takes on a corrupt nexus in Bhoj, exposing Dada Bhai's sinister empire. As deceit unravels, one question remains-can truth defeat power?

title: Baazigar
desc: A ruthless killer seeking revenge seduces a businessman's elder daughter, stages her murder as suicide, then sets out to destroy the rest of her family.

title: Bade Miyan Chote Miyan
desc: Arjun and Pyare, two cops from the same station, are wrongly accused of multiple crimes. Their probe reveals the real offenders are their own lookalike impostors.

title: Jism
desc: Kabir, an alcoholic lawyer, falls for Sonia, wife of a wealthy traveler. She lures him into murdering her husband, but her shocking motive leaves Kabir stunned.

title: English Vinglish
desc: Shashi, a housewife and caterer, is mocked for not knowing English. Her journey to learn the language helps her rediscover herself and prove her worth as a mother and wife.
